title: Bramley and rhubarb pots with almond crunch

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Apples, rhubarb, orange, honey, butter, nuts, seeds and natural yoghurt are all plain kitchen staples with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Bramleys, rhubarb, almonds, pumpkin seeds and natural yoghurt are everyday Tesco items at ordinary prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a saucepan, a small frying pan and glasses, using simple stewing and toasting.

works.reason: Bramleys collapse readily in 8 to 10 minutes covered with the orange juice, and 800g fruit with 400g yoghurt makes four generous snack pots.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers peeling and coring the apples, chopping and toasting, and the 40 cook minutes matches 10 minutes stewing plus 30 minutes cooling.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and the cinnamon appear in the steps, names match their ids, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: Stored Bramleys with early garden rhubarb suit early April, and the apple is clearly the bulk and point of the pot.

plain_voice.reason: Clear, homely British instructions a beginner could follow without any restaurant language.

hearty_healthy.reason: Fruit, yoghurt, nuts and seeds with modest honey make a real-food snack a family would happily eat.
